body_es: Los gráficos de burndown (gráficos descendentes) muestran el trabajo pendiente en el eje Y y los días en el eje X, visualizando cómo el equipo reduce el trabajo en el tiempo. Una línea ideal descendente representa el progreso esperado; desviaciones indican problemas como scope creep o velocidad variable. Los gráficos de burnup (gráficos ascendentes) muestran trabajo completado acumulado, haciendo más visible el progreso hacia la meta. El burnup también revela si el scope del proyecto ha cambiado comparando la línea de meta con el progreso. Ambos gráficos son herramientas de visualización poderosas que facilitan conversaciones sobre el progreso y ayudan al equipo a identificar cuando necesita ajustar.
body_en: Burndown charts (downward charts) show remaining work on the Y-axis and days on the X-axis, visualizing how the team reduces work over time. An ideal downward line represents expected progress; deviations indicate problems like scope creep or variable velocity. Burnup charts (upward charts) show accumulated completed work, making progress toward the goal more visible. Burnup also reveals whether project scope has changed by comparing the goal line with progress. Both charts are powerful visualization tools that facilitate conversations about progress and help the team identify when adjustments are needed.

    "sprint_id": "Sprint 48",
    "total_story_points": 40,

    "daily_data": [
      {"day": 0, "remaining_points": 40, "day_name": "Day 0 (Planning)"},
      {"day": 1, "remaining_points": 35, "completed_today": 5},
      {"day": 2, "remaining_points": 32, "completed_today": 3},
      {"day": 3, "remaining_points": 28, "completed_today": 4},

      {"day": 5, "remaining_points": 22, "completed_today": 3, "note": "Holiday"},
      {"day": 6, "remaining_points": 22, "completed_today": 0, "note": "No work"},
      {"day": 7, "remaining_points": 18, "completed_today": 4},
      {"day": 8, "remaining_points": 12, "completed_today": 6},
      {"day": 9, "remaining_points": 8, "completed_today": 4},
      {"day": 10, "remaining_points": 3, "completed_today": 5, "status": "Carry over 3 points"}
    ],
    "ideal_line": "40 points declining by 4 pts/day",
    "actual_trend": "Slight delay Days 5-6, recovered by Day 9"
  },
  
  "sprint_burnup": {
    "sprint_id": "Sprint 48",
    "total_story_points": 40,
    "daily_data": [
      {"day": 0, "completed_points": 0, "total_scope": 40},
      {"day": 1, "completed_points": 5, "total_scope": 40},
      {"day": 2, "completed_points": 8, "total_scope": 40},
      {"day": 3, "completed_points": 12, "total_scope": 40},
      {"day": 4, "completed_points": 15, "total_scope": 42, "note": "Scope +2 pts"},
      {"day": 5, "completed_points": 15, "total_scope": 42},
      {"day": 6, "completed_points": 15, "total_scope": 42},
      {"day": 7, "completed_points": 19, "total_scope": 42},
      {"day": 8, "completed_points": 25, "total_scope": 42},
      {"day": 9, "completed_points": 29, "total_scope": 42},
      {"day": 10, "completed_points": 37, "total_scope": 42, "remaining": 5}
    ],
    "scope_change": "Increased by 2 points on Day 4",
    "velocity_observation": "Acceleration in Days 8-10"
  }
}
